risk_note: RV2 by path (admin module). Implements the six CT-24o account writes (create with a one-time initial password, regenerate the initial password, disable / enable, reset another account's TOTP, rename) and removes their planned marks. Initial password: 20 characters by CSPRNG, only its hash stored, shown once in the response, never logged or audited. Disable, TOTP reset and regeneration record a per-account void instant in Redis inside the transaction; admin_token, login tickets and step-up tokens issued before it are void; admin-check also requires totp_bound_at. Disable cancels the account's pending / running exports in the same transaction. Login tickets carry the row_version they were issued on and are re-checked at every step (round-1 S1). Export create / retry lock the creator row FOR SHARE and require active (round-1 S2). No migration. Rule tests by an independent Claude (approvals #36), red before the implementation; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in two rounds.
